subject.title: refactor(meeting-bot): extract browser meeting-bot core behind MeetingPlatformAdapter

question: Should OpenClaw commit to the full 81-export `meeting-runtime` plugin API now, or keep most implementation internal until a second platform proves the abstraction boundary?
rationale: The code is plausible, but a single current adapter cannot establish which of the many new exports should become long-lived external compatibility contracts.

options.title: Narrow before publishing
options.body: Keep shared implementation internal and expose only the minimum adapter contract demonstrated by Google Meet and the next platform.

options.title: Accept the full SDK surface
options.body: Merge the current barrel with explicit ownership of its external compatibility and deprecation obligations.

options.title: Pause the extraction
options.body: Retain the runtime in the Google Meet plugin until the multi-platform meeting design has a reviewed second consumer.

recommendation.title: Narrow before publishing
recommendation.body: Keep shared implementation internal and expose only the minimum adapter contract demonstrated by Google Meet and the next platform.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current extraction and the four merged consolidation phases that establish its architecture.
